name: mcp-per-diem
description: Daily travel allowances on bundled public rate tables: Poland, HMRC and GSA.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: perdiem_rates
tools.description: List a scheme's bundled daily allowance rates with the authority, instrument, source URL and effective date they came from. Filter by country or city. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: perdiem_calc
tools.description: Calculate the daily travel allowance for one trip: the amount per day and the total in the scheme's currency, with the partial-day fraction and the meal deductions the scheme's own rule applies. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: trip_record
tools.description: Calculate a trip and save it under a name, with the traveller taken from the shared business profile. Returns the TRIP-YYYY-NNNN id. Free tier: 5 trips a calendar month.

tools.name: trip_list
tools.description: List saved trips with the scheme, destination, dates and total on each, and a total per currency. Filter by scheme, destination, traveller, project and start date range. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: trip_export
tools.description: Return the exact expense_add arguments for a saved trip, one payload per currency, ready to pass to the expense-tracker server. It writes nothing itself: see the note in the answer. Pro.

tools.name: perdiem_report
tools.description: Total the saved trips per scheme and per calendar month, in each scheme's own currency, with the day count and the trips behind every figure. Pro.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
